verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page explicitly claims organization-wide enforcement of code quality policies and compliance requirements through standardized, customizable merge checks (docs-7). This is reinforced by claims of enforcing coding standards, CI/CD policies and change-management workflows across teams and repos (docs-6), and by third-party code reports surfaced on the PR screen (docs-11). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how custom merge checks are configured and enforced (e.g., blocking merges, check types, plan tiers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
